title: Practice 1: «For a while»: по- and про-

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **проговорил** — проговори́ть (perfective): to say, to utter; to talk (for a while). Wiktionary: про- + говори́ть.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to keep silent, to be silent (for a while)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: проговори́ть — to say, to utter; постоя́ть — to stand (for a while); прожи́ть — to live, to outlast; помолча́ть — to keep silent, to be silent (for a while).

exercises.q: You will live a hundred years.
exercises.why: **проживёшь** — прожи́ть (perfective): to live, to outlast; to reside (for some time); (transitive) to spend, to run through. Wiktionary: про- + жить.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **проживёт** — прожи́ть (perfective): to live, to outlast; to reside (for some time); (transitive) to spend, to run through. Wiktionary: про- + жить.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **пробежал** — пробежа́ть (perfective): to run past, to run through; to run a certain distance or for some time; to skim, to scan, to look through. Wiktionary: про- + бежа́ть.
